widths.boundary_rule: Coastline or ice-shelf face to the offshore location where depth-integrated velocity is 15% of its value at the current center, identified by maximum gradient of net transport.
widths.extraction_method: Published Table 2 and Table 1 values transcribed from visually inspected final original, with source definitions and sampling limits retained.
widths.geographic_scope: Source section 1: West Antarctic Peninsula continental shelf.
widths.layer: Geostrophic velocity referenced to 400 m; depth integral from surface to the variable 34.4 psu isohaline, not a fixed 0-400 m layer.
widths.name: Antarctic Coastal Current

original_regional_context.display_method_note: Moving-median seal-profile composite, 400 m geostrophic reference, surface-to-34.4 psu integration. Table 1 counts retain summer/winter sampling and the section 6 prose discrepancy. No fixed-depth layer, dated edge coordinates or width error supplied.

source_properties.signed_transport_convention: Negative westward, positive eastward; 400 m geostrophic reference.

widths.range_interpretation: One published composite cross-shelf extent; differences among sections are spatial, not annual extrema or confidence limits.
remaining_gates: Acquire raw calibrated profiles and reproduce geostrophic reference, moving median and edge extraction.
Recover geographic coastline/ice-face and offshore-edge coordinates before footprints or physical state intersections.
Compute compatible repeated sections and width errors before annual or seasonal margins.
Independent scientific admission.
widths.section_orientation: Source composite cross-shelf transect; no geographic paired edges transcribed.

widths.source_locator: Final original PDF p11 / printed p4189, Table 2 row 1; Table 1 on p5 / p4183; methods section 2.3 pp4-5; Fig.9 p12 and section 4 p13.
widths.source_quality_note: Published composite section, not a dated synoptic width. Table 1 counts determine sampling composition; section 6 contradicts the prose assertion that all sections except 1 are winter-dominated.
widths.time_convention: Historical composite of disjoint seal-profile sampling periods and both seasons; no exact section width dates or monthly width curve extracted.
